mapper.select: SELECT * FROM TBL_MONITORING WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND ALERT_LEVEL IN ('HIGH', 'MEDIUM', 'LOW', 'CRITICAL') AND ALERT_MESSAGE IS NOT NULL AND ALERT_MESSAGE != '' ORDER BY CASE ALERT_LEVEL WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, MONITOR_TIME DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT * FROM TBL_MONITORING WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND ALERT_LEVEL = 'CRITICAL' ORDER BY MONITOR_TIME DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN FAILED_COUNT = 0 THEN 100 WHEN FAILED_COUNT IS NULL THEN 100 ELSE (SUCCESS_COUNT * 100.0 / (SUCCESS_COUNT + FAILED_COUNT)) END), 0) AS avgHealthScore, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN TRANSACTION_COUNT IS NULL OR TRANSACTION_COUNT = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (SUCCESS_COUNT * 100.0 / TRANSACTION_COUNT) END), 0) AS avgSuccessRate, COALESCE(AVG(AVG_PROCESSING_TIME), 0) AS avgProcessingTime, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN FAILED_COUNT > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 0) AS avgSystemLoad, COUNT(*) AS totalMonitors, SUM(COALESCE(TRANSACTION_COUNT, 0)) AS totalTransactions, SUM(COALESCE(SUCCESS_COUNT, 0)) AS totalSuccess, SUM(COALESCE(FAILED_COUNT, 0)) AS totalFailed FROM TBL_MONITORING WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND MONITOR_TIME >= SYSDATE - INTERVAL '1' HOUR

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN ALERT_LEVEL = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 END) AS criticalAlerts, COUNT(CASE WHEN ALERT_LEVEL = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END) AS highAlerts, COUNT(CASE WHEN ALERT_LEVEL = 'MEDIUM' THEN 1 END) AS mediumAlerts, COUNT(CASE WHEN ALERT_LEVEL = 'LOW' THEN 1 END) AS lowAlerts, COUNT(*) AS totalAlerts, COALESCE(SUM(TRANSACTION_COUNT), 0) AS totalTransactions, COALESCE(SUM(SUCCESS_COUNT), 0) AS totalSuccess, COALESCE(SUM(FAILED_COUNT), 0) AS totalFailed, COALESCE(AVG(AVG_PROCESSING_TIME), 0) AS avgProcessingTime FROM TBL_MONITORING WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND MONITOR_TIME >= SYSDATE - INTERVAL '24' HOUR
